source.description: Starter benchmark silver premium table by state and age band. Approximate national + six-state sample, sourced from Kaiser Family Foundation benchmark silver premium reports (healthinsurance.org) as a defensible order-of-magnitude for ACA subsidy estimation.

methodology.description: Benchmark silver premiums vary by rating area; this table uses a representative urban area per state as the anchor. Values are pre-subsidy annual premiums for a single enrollee at the given age. Refresh annually when HHS updates the benchmark plans (typically Q4 each year).
